summary.text: Hal Slager (Harold Slager on Ballotpedia) is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 15 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously held the same seat from 2012 to 2018 and served on the Schererville Town Council.

paragraphs.text: Slager earned a B.S. from Butler University in 1981.
His career experience includes working as an accountant with Melvin Simon & Associates, as president of TRICO, and as founder of Triangle Equities.
Slager served on the Schererville Town Council as an at-large member from 2003 to 2012.
He represented Indiana House District 15 from 2012 to 2018 and returned to the seat on November 4, 2020, succeeding Chris Chyung.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
